GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-01-16T15:05:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: New installation on Ubuntu VM: Password required for user default. 
Description: I can't get the initial setup to work on my newly created Ubuntu 18.04.3 LTS virtual machine.
I followed the instructions on the website by executing the following terminal commands:

```
sudo apt-get install dirmngr    # optional
sudo apt-key adv --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv E0C56BD4    # optional
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install clickhouse-client clickhouse-server
```

This should suffice, right? I then start the server, try to start the client and this is what happens:
```
taxel@taxel-VirtualBox:~$ sudo service clickhouse-server start
taxel@taxel-VirtualBox:~$ clickhouse-client
ClickHouse client version 19.17.6.36 (official build).
Connecting to localhost:9000 as user default.
Code: 194. DB::Exception: Received from localhost:9000. DB::Exception: Password required for user default. 
```
I also tried changing the default password from `<password></password>` to `<password>123</password>` and logging in via `clickhouse-client --password=123` but it outputs that the password is wrong (and yes, I have ensured the xml file is saved and the server is restarted)

Any help would be much appreciated.

The problem and solution are related to configuration settings in ClickHouse's XML configuration files. To verify a solution, one would need to check if the password configuration in the XML file is correctly set and if the server is properly restarting to apply those changes. This is a configuration issue that can be analyzed without building any code - it involves editing configuration files, restarting services, and using the pre-built ClickHouse client.
